prompt: Write a note to a friend about what your team delivered over the last year and a bit. Aim for about 400 words. Reply with the note only.
final_message:
Hey [Friend's name],

It's been a while, so here's a catch-up on what our team has been up to for the past year or so. I've left brackets where you should fill in the real specifics.

The big one was [headline project]. We started in [month/year] with a small group and a vague brief. We shipped it in [month/year], and [number/result, e.g. X users, Y% faster, Z cost saved] came out of it. I'm proud of how the team handled the messy middle, when the requirements changed twice and we still held the date.

We also finished [second project]. It wasn't glamorous, but it removed a lot of daily friction. [Describe the before and after in a sentence.] People stopped complaining about it, which is the best review we could ask for.

Along the way we did some less visible work:

- **Reliability:** We [paid down tech debt, improved monitoring, cut incidents by X]. Nights and weekends have been much quieter.
- **Process:** We [adopted a new release cadence, started doing retros, tightened code review]. It's made handoffs smoother and surprises rarer.
- **People:** We [welcomed new teammates, mentored someone into a bigger role, ran a workshop]. The group feels stronger than it did a year ago.

Not everything landed. [Name one thing that slipped or got cut] didn't make it, mostly because [honest reason]. We learned from it, and it's now on the plan for [next quarter].

What I'm happiest about isn't any single launch. We built trust: with each other, and with the people who depend on what we make. Looking back, the pace was sustainable, and that's rarer than it should be.

Next up, we're focused on [upcoming priority]. I'm cautiously excited. If it goes the way the last year did, we'll be in good shape.

Enough about me. How have you been? I want to hear what you've been working on, and how [something personal you know about them] turned out. Let's grab a coffee or a call soon. I'll buy, since I owe you for [thing].

Talk soon,
[Your name]
